notes.title: Updates To Jungle Platoshira and New Simra Animations!
notes.notes: [p]Hi! Jungle Warriors! [/p][p][/p][p]There have been changes to the World of Jungle Shadow With Platoshira looking fresher, more natural and realistic with:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Sunlight beams[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Global Lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Post Processing[/p][/*][*][p]Bloom[/p][/*][*][p]White Balance[/p][/*][*][p]Optional Motion Blur (as motion blur will be off by default and its usually better for a more clearer view on the game)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Some New Simra Animations such as:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Run Animation[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Animation[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Animation[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]AND:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New Frog Animations (Stomp Attack or even Stomp and Tongue Attack, it looks really good)[/p][/*][*][p]Waterfall[/p][/*][*][p]New Puddle Look and Animations[/p][/*][*][p]Bird Animations[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675318/e9a40572a2c7fe01b0a423d5920c4f3cfe064d44.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Most of these will be shown in the upcoming trailer! Stay Tuned and follow up for more announcements![/p]
